name: Dangote
source: CRON 2026-11-12: 9M 2026 column added from Dangote Cement Plc condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss for the three and nine months ended 30 September 2026 (NGX filing, approved 27 October 2026), Naira million scaled to units, group column. Printed lines: Revenue 3,774,208; Production cost of sales 1,387,762 leaving Gross profit 2,386,446; Administrative expenses 226,108 plus Selling and distribution expenses 618,872 = Operating Expenses 844,980; Operating profit 1,567,745 is after Other income 25,749 and a 530 reversal of impairment of financial assets; Finance costs 120,798 less Finance income 23,819 = Net Finance Costs 96,979; Profit before tax 1,472,503 is operating profit less net finance costs plus Share of profit from associate 1,737; Income tax 497,709 leaving Profit for the period 974,794, of which 977,853 is attributable to owners and -3,059 to non-controlling interests; basic and diluted earnings per share 58.37. Checks: 3,774,208 less 1,387,762 equals 2,386,446; 1,472,503 less 497,709 equals 974,794. The three-month column agrees with the nine-month column and with the stored H1 2026 column: H1 2026 revenue 2,513,932 plus Q3 1,260,276 equals 3,774,208 and H1 2026 net profit 638,534 plus Q3 336,260 equals 974,794. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity left empty because this column carries no balance sheet input. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | FY2025+FY2024 rebuilt from the audited statements (AfricanFinancials ng-dangce); prior parse had scrambled labels | gaps filled from stockanalysis.com only where the source row reproduced an already stored figure of the SAME row within 1.5 percent of the stored value

source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from the issuer unaudited interim financial statements for the three and six months ended 30 June 2026 (Dangote Cement Plc, cement.dangote.com), condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss, six months column (NGN million): Revenue 2,513,932; Production cost of sales 924,308; Gross profit 1,589,624; Operating Expenses 540,488 (administrative 138,636 plus selling and distribution 401,852); Profit from operating activities (EBIT) 1,059,597; Net Finance Costs 95,859 (finance costs 112,105 less finance income 16,246); Profit Before Tax 981,387; Income Tax 342,853; Profit for the period 638,534; EPS 38.22. UNIT: NGN. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
